title: Bring a Guest | 6 Free Visits | GHF
description: The Power Of Friends Guest program — each guest visiting with a member gets 6 free visits.

blocks.sub: Workouts are better with your favorite humans. Every guest visiting with a member gets 6 free visits — classes, pool, sauna, all of it. Grab your friend; we'll handle the rest.

blocks.title: Bring as many friends as you *like*
blocks.text: You may bring as many guests as you'd like during your membership (but just 2 at one time). If you and your guest are unable to work out together, you may request a guest pass. Guests are welcome to join the gym online anytime.
items: Guests must be accompanied by a current GHF member
Guests may visit GHF facilities up to 6 times total
Guests must check in and present photo ID
Minimum age is 13 years | 13–17 must be accompanied by parent/guardian
No special passes or advanced reservations required

blocks.title: The power of *friends*
blocks.text: Guests are welcome to join the gym online anytime — or grab a free all-access pass and see what GHF is all about.
